Implement one new pipeline step in the repo at /Users/havarddaleng/Documents/git/repos/ardoq/ardoq-ai-research/ardoq-ai-research (the git repo is nested; the outer dir only has an empty `.nuggets`). Work directly on the current branch `AI-1925-query-improvement`. No worktree, no commits, no `AI-GENERATED` markers. Keep docstrings and comments terse. Never mention spec, issue or planning ids in code. Relevant workspace nuggets are at /Users/havarddaleng/Documents/git/repos/ardoq/.aispace/nuggets/investigator-20260923-103313.md and investigator-20260923-sparqlclient.md; read them first.

## Goal
A manually triggered step that runs every SPARQL query in `ontology/data/flagged-queries-sparql/queries*.rq` (only the first query with `--test-run`) against the live local GraphLake. It writes the result rows plus any explicit errors GraphLake or the transport reports to one JSON file. No term checks, no pattern decomposition and no other inference: only results and explicit errors.

## Existing conventions (verified; follow them)
All paths are relative to `ontology/`.
- Entry point: `src/pipeline/run_pipeline.py`, run from `ontology/` as `python -m src.pipeline.run_pipeline --steps <csv|all> [--force] [--test-run]`.
- Steps are registered in `VALID_STEPS` (~:45-48) and `step_map` (~:90-101). `all` runs `VALID_STEPS` in order. **This step must NOT run under `--steps all`.** It is only selectable by name. Change how `all` expands minimally, e.g. keep a separate set of manual-only steps excluded from `all`.
- Step shape: `run(source_dir: Path, output_dir: Path, *, force=False, test_run=False)`, plus a standalone `main()` with argparse. Mirror `src/pipeline/gen_queries.py`: `output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`; skip the existing output file unless `--force`; `print` with a `[run-flagged-queries]` prefix, `flush=True`, paths printed relative to the project root; on test-run print `--test-run: stopping after first query`.
- Config: `src/pipeline/config.py` has `PROJECT_ROOT`, `load_dotenv(PROJECT_ROOT/".env")`, `class Paths` (with `flagged_queries_sparql`) and `class Models`. Add `Paths.flagged_results = data/flagged-results` and a `class GraphLake` read from env with these defaults:
  - `GRAPHLAKE_URL=http://localhost:8095`
  - `GRAPHLAKE_STORE=ardoqbundlesproduction`
  - `GRAPHLAKE_BRANCH=main`
  - `GRAPHLAKE_USERNAME=admin`
  - `GRAPHLAKE_ADMIN_PASSWORD=ardoq_graphlake_admin_pass`
  - `GRAPHLAKE_QUERY_TIMEOUT=60s`
- Dependencies: `src/pipeline/requirements.txt` only has `anthropic` and `python-dotenv`. Use stdlib `urllib.request`/`json` only; add no deps.
- `.rq` format: each file concatenates several queries. Each block starts with a header line `# <FlaggedClass>  (groupN.dle)` (two spaces; written at `gen_queries.py:92`), followed by its own PREFIX lines, `#` comments and a `SELECT ?id ?name ?value ...`. Split on that header line. There are 28 queries across `queries1.rq`–`queries6.rq`. Sort files numerically by N.

## GraphLake contract (verified live on localhost:8095)
- Login: `POST /admin/authenticate/password`, JSON `{"username","password"}`, returns 200 `{"token": "<jwt>"}` or 401. The JWT expires after 15 min: on a 401 from a query, log in again once and retry.
- Pre-check: `GET /stores` returns a JSON array of names; `GET /stores/{store}/branches` returns a JSON array. Both use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. If the login fails or the store/branch is missing: run no queries, still write the output file with a top-level `error`, exit non-zero.
- Query: `POST /stores/{urlquoted store}/query?branch=<branch>&timeout=<timeout>`. Headers: `Content-Type: application/sparql-query`, `Accept: application/sparql-results+json` (mandatory, otherwise the response is XML), `Authorization: Bearer`. Body: raw query text (send the block including its header comment). A success is 200 SPARQL JSON `{"head":{"vars":[...]},"results":{"bindings":[{var:{"type","value",...}}]}}`.
- Errors are JSON `{"error": "...", "details": {...}}`:
  - 400: syntax or evaluation errors. `details` has `code`, `message`, `line`, `column`, `found`, `expected`, `hint` and `source_line`. Store `details` verbatim.
  - 504: query timed out or canceled.
  - 429 with `Retry-After`: resource limit. Retry once after the delay.
  - 404: `{"error":"branch not found"}`.
- The body is streamed, so a failure mid-stream can truncate the JSON. Treat a JSON decode failure as an error.

## Output
Write `data/flagged-results/{store}-{branch}.json`:
```
{store, branch, graphlake_url, run_at (ISO UTC), test_run, error (null or {kind, message, http_status?}),
 summary: {queries, ok, error, rows},
 queries: [{flagged_class, group, source_file, sparql, status: "ok"|"error", http_status, duration_ms,
            row_count, vars, rows: [{var: value, ...}] (flatten bindings to plain values; keep raw binding type info too if cheap, e.g. under "raw"),
            error: null | {kind: "http"|"timeout"|"rate_limited"|"auth"|"connection"|"invalid_response", message, details (verbatim GraphLake details or null), body (raw response text, truncated to ~4KB, when not JSON)}}]}
```
- A per-query failure never aborts the run.
- Exit code: 0 if every query is ok; non-zero if any query errored or a pre-check failed.
- Print one progress line per query (class, status, row count or error message) and a final summary line.

## Verify
GraphLake is running locally with the store populated. Run once from `ontology/` with the repo venv at `../.venv` (Python 3.14): `python -m src.pipeline.run_pipeline --steps run-flagged-queries --test-run --force`, then without `--test-run`. Confirm the JSON is written. Confirm `--steps all` does not include the step; check that from the code, do not run `all`, because it would call the LLM. Also run the module standalone: `python -m src.pipeline.run_flagged_queries --help`. Verify once and stop. No repeated runs or tangential bug hunts.

## Report back
Tersely: files changed, the exact run commands (pipeline and standalone, with flags) and the summary line from the full run. If you hit a repo-level convention a cold agent would need, record it with the save-nugget skill, after checking the existing nuggets first.

# Communication

- Maximise conciseness in every response unless instructed otherwise. Cut every word that carries no information.
- No filler words. No throat-clearing, transitions, or narration of the response itself or of what you are about to do.
- Never open by confirming or restating a premise the user already asserted ("It's real:", "Yes,", "You're right"). Take the premise as given and answer from it.
- Minimise personalised language: no praise, no apologies, no reference to the user's state or intent. State facts.
- Never assume. If a fact is not established, verify it or say it is unknown. Not having found evidence is not evidence of absence: say "I don't know whether X" or "nothing in the repo states X", never "X is not the case".
- Use plain, concrete language. Never coin a vague metaphor or abstract phrase to stand in for a specific fact ("wire awkwardness", "impedance mismatch", "shape friction") — name the actual thing instead ("field names differ between the API and domain types"). If a term would need its own explanation, it is the wrong term.
- Never add a caveat, hedge, or qualifying clause unless specific evidence in the current context supports it. A qualifier without a cited basis is deleted, not softened.
- Zero tolerance for rambling. Answer with the minimum text that fully communicates the answer, then stop. No summary of what was just said, no "next steps" unless asked, no listing of things not done.
- Every sentence must carry information the user does not already have. If a sentence could be deleted without losing content, delete it.
- Zero tolerance for LLM filler phrasing: no "it's worth noting", "essentially", "in essence", "at its core", "the key insight", "this means that", "let's", "I'll go ahead and", "great question". Say the thing.
- Answer the exact question asked. No adjacent information, no background the user did not request, no options the user did not ask to compare.
- Default response length for a question is 1-3 sentences. Exceed that only when the user asks for depth or the answer genuinely cannot fit — never to add context, examples, or structure the user did not request.
- Lead with the direct answer. If the question is yes/no, the first word is Yes or No. If it asks for a value, location, or name, state it first. Elaboration comes after, and only if it is needed to make the answer usable.
- Never substitute a related question for the one asked. If the literal question cannot be answered, say why in one sentence, then ask for the missing information — do not answer a different question instead.
- Prefer short declarative sentences over compound ones. One fact per sentence. Cut adjectives and adverbs that do not change meaning.
- Ambiguity is a defect. Every referent must be explicit: name the file, function, field, value, or command rather than "it", "this", "that part", "the thing".
- No structural padding: skip preambles, headings, tables, and bullet lists when a sentence or two suffices.
- A request to locate code is answered with locations only — file paths, symbols, line numbers. Do not explain how the code works, its flow, or its design unless explicitly asked.
- When a search turns up something only tangentially relevant, give it one line naming what it appears to be for and why it likely does not apply. Never a breakdown of it.
- When asked to identify, name, or show something, do not also explain its significance, purpose, or how it differs from something else. Identification is the whole answer.
- When the user names a specific file, function, or artifact to explain, explain that artifact's own contents and control flow. Do not substitute the things it calls or the wider flow it belongs to.
- A terse follow-up narrows scope to the single case in play. Answer only that case — do not re-enumerate every variant or location.
- A correction about length or style applies to every later turn in the session, not just the next one. Re-check it before sending any response longer than a few sentences.
- Never append unrequested addenda — no "practical note", "caveat", "gotcha", "tip", "in practice", or closing recommendation. If the user did not ask for advice, do not give advice. End the response when the question is answered.

# Delegation

- Default search/exploration agent is `investigator`, not `Explore` or `general-purpose`. Use it for any codebase question worth delegating.
- Use `Explore` only for a narrow locate-this lookup where no synthesis is needed.

# Durable findings (nuggets)

- Whenever you or an agent hits a piece of information that is about the *repo* rather than the task — an unusual or repo-specific convention, documentation explicitly stating "do X this way", a structural principle, a test/build peculiarity, a deliberate exception or trap — stop and record it via the `save-nugget` skill.
- The test is: would another agent arriving cold write worse code or waste effort without knowing this? If yes, it is a nugget. If it only answers the current question, it is not — that goes in the report.

- [Terse, no ornamental framing](terse-no-ornamental-framing.md) — drop phrases like "why it's worse than it looks"; state findings/verdicts directly, applies to all explanations

"""Orchestrate the full AI reporting pipeline.

Usage (from project root):
    python -m src.pipeline.run_pipeline [--steps STEPS] [--force] [--test-run]

Steps (comma-separated, or 'all'):
    infer         Run DL inference pass 1  → data/dl-inferred/
    extend        Run DL inference pass 2  → data/dl-extended/
    queries       Individual queries from dl-inferred/ → data/flagged-queries/
    queries-ext   Individual queries from dl-extended/ → data/flagged-extended/
    reports       Merged report queries from dl-inferred/ → data/report-queries/
    reports-ext   Merged report queries from dl-extended/ → data/report-extended/
    queries-sparql       Individual SPARQL queries from dl-inferred/ → data/flagged-queries-sparql/
    queries-sparql-ext   Individual SPARQL queries from dl-extended/ → data/flagged-extended-sparql/
    reports-sparql       Merged SPARQL report queries from dl-inferred/ → data/report-queries-sparql/
    reports-sparql-ext   Merged SPARQL report queries from dl-extended/ → data/report-extended-sparql/

Default (--steps all) runs every step in the order above, skipping any whose
output already exists (override with --force).

Examples:
    # Full pipeline from scratch
    python -m src.pipeline.run_pipeline --steps all

    # Regenerate only query files
    python -m src.pipeline.run_pipeline --steps queries,reports --force

    # Test one item through each step without committing to full runs
    python -m src.pipeline.run_pipeline --steps queries,reports --test-run
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
if str(_PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_PROJECT_ROOT))

from src.pipeline.config import Paths
from src.pipeline.languages import SPARQL
from src.pipeline import infer_dl, gen_queries, gen_report

VALID_STEPS = [
    "infer", "extend", "queries", "queries-ext", "reports", "reports-ext",
    "queries-sparql", "queries-sparql-ext", "reports-sparql", "reports-sparql-ext",
]


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Run the Foundation AI reporting pipeline.",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog=__doc__,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--steps",
        default="all",
        metavar="STEPS",
        help=f"Comma-separated list of steps to run, or 'all'. "
             f"Valid steps: {', '.join(VALID_STEPS)}",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--force",
        action="store_true",
        help="Regenerate output files even if they already exist.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--test-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Process only one item per step (useful for validating prompts cheaply).",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.steps.strip().lower() == "all":
        steps = list(VALID_STEPS)
    else:

        invalid = [s for s in steps if s not in VALID_STEPS]
        if invalid:
            print(
                f"Unknown step(s): {invalid}\nValid steps: {', '.join(VALID_STEPS)}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            sys.exit(1)

    kwargs = {"force": args.force, "test_run": args.test_run}

    step_map = {
        "infer":       lambda: infer_dl.run_pass(1, Paths.dl_inferred, **kwargs),
        "extend":      lambda: infer_dl.run_pass(2, Paths.dl_extended, **kwargs),
        "queries":     lambda: gen_queries.run(Paths.dl_inferred, Paths.flagged_queries, **kwargs),
        "queries-ext": lambda: gen_queries.run(Paths.dl_extended, Paths.flagged_extended, **kwargs),
        "reports":     lambda: gen_report.run(Paths.dl_inferred, Paths.report_queries, **kwargs),
        "reports-ext": lambda: gen_report.run(Paths.dl_extended, Paths.report_extended, **kwargs),

        "queries-sparql-ext": lambda: gen_queries.run(Paths.dl_extended, Paths.flagged_extended_sparql, lang=SPARQL, **kwargs),
        "reports-sparql":     lambda: gen_report.run(Paths.dl_inferred, Paths.report_queries_sparql, lang=SPARQL, **kwargs),
        "reports-sparql-ext": lambda: gen_report.run(Paths.dl_extended, Paths.report_extended_sparql, lang=SPARQL, **kwargs),
    }

    for step in steps:
        step_map[step]()

"""Generate individual queries for each Flagged class in group DL files.

One query per Flagged class, one output file per group.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
if str(_PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_PROJECT_ROOT))

from src.pipeline.config import Paths, Models
from src.pipeline.languages import GREMLIN, SPARQL, Language
from src.pipeline.llm_utils import create_client, extract_single_query

_FLAGGED_RE = re.compile(r"^([a-zA-Z]+) \u2291 Flagged", re.MULTILINE)


def _read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def run(
    source_dir: Path,
    output_dir: Path,
    *,
    lang: Language = GREMLIN,
    force: bool = False,
    test_run: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Generate one query file per group DL file in source_dir."""
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    group_files = sorted(source_dir.glob("group*.dle"))
    if not group_files:
        print(f"[gen-queries] No group*.dle files found in {source_dir.relative_to(_PROJECT_ROOT)}.")
        return

    core = _read(Paths.foundation_core)
    prompt_template = _read(Paths.prompts / lang.query_prompt)
    client = create_client()

    for group_file in group_files:
        suffix = re.search(r"(\d+)\.dle$", group_file.name).group(1)
        out_path = output_dir / f"queries{suffix}{lang.extension}"

        if out_path.exists() and not force:
            print(f"[gen-queries] {out_path.name} already exists, skipping. Use --force to regenerate.")
            continue

        group_content = _read(group_file)
        flagged_classes = _FLAGGED_RE.findall(group_content)
        if not flagged_classes:
            print(f"[gen-queries] No Flagged classes in {group_file.name}, skipping.")
            continue

        print(
            f"[gen-queries] {group_file.name}: {len(flagged_classes)} class(es) ...",
            flush=True,
        )

        with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
            for flagged in flagged_classes:
                print(f"  {flagged} ...", flush=True)

                user_content = [
                    {"type": "text", "text": f"=== foundation-core.dle ===\n{core}"},
                    {"type": "text", "text": f"=== {group_file.name} ===\n{group_content}"},
                    {"type": "text", "text": prompt_template.format(flagged=flagged)},
                ]

                with client.messages.stream(
                    model=Models.query_gen,
                    max_tokens=16000,
                    thinking={"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 15999},
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user_content}],
                ) as stream:
                    response = stream.get_final_message()

                result_text = next(
                    (b.text for b in response.content if b.type == "text"), None
                )
                if result_text is None:
                    print(f"  WARNING: no text block for {flagged}, skipping.")
                    continue

                code = extract_single_query(result_text, lang)
                out.write(f"{lang.comment_prefix} {flagged}  ({group_file.name})\n")
                out.write(code)
                out.write("\n\n")
                out.flush()

                if test_run:
                    print("  --test-run: stopping after first class.")
                    return

        print(f"  Written: {out_path.relative_to(_PROJECT_ROOT)}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Generate individual queries for Flagged classes."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--source", choices=["inferred", "extended"], default="inferred",
        help="Which group DL directory to read from.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--lang", choices=["gremlin", "sparql"], default="gremlin",
        help="Which query language to generate.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Overwrite existing output files.")
    parser.add_argument("--test-run", action="store_true", help="Process only the first class and stop.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    source_dir = Paths.dl_inferred if args.source == "inferred" else Paths.dl_extended
    if args.lang == "gremlin":
        lang = GREMLIN
        output_dir = Paths.flagged_queries if args.source == "inferred" else Paths.flagged_extended
    else:
        lang = SPARQL
        output_dir = Paths.flagged_queries_sparql if args.source == "inferred" else Paths.flagged_extended_sparql
    run(source_dir, output_dir, lang=lang, force=args.force, test_run=args.test_run)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Generate individual queries for each Flagged class in group DL files.

One query per Flagged class, one output file per group.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
if str(_PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_PROJECT_ROOT))

from src.pipeline.config import Paths, Models
from src.pipeline.languages import GREMLIN, SPARQL, Language
from src.pipeline.llm_utils import create_client, extract_single_query

_FLAGGED_RE = re.compile(r"^([a-zA-Z]+) \u2291 Flagged", re.MULTILINE)


def _read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def run(
    source_dir: Path,
    output_dir: Path,
    *,
    lang: Language = GREMLIN,
    force: bool = False,
    test_run: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Generate one query file per group DL file in source_dir."""
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    group_files = sorted(source_dir.glob("group*.dle"))
    if not group_files:
        print(f"[gen-queries] No group*.dle files found in {source_dir.relative_to(_PROJECT_ROOT)}.")
        return

    core = _read(Paths.foundation_core)
    prompt_template = _read(Paths.prompts / lang.query_prompt)
    client = create_client()

    for group_file in group_files:
        suffix = re.search(r"(\d+)\.dle$", group_file.name).group(1)
        out_path = output_dir / f"queries{suffix}{lang.extension}"

        if out_path.exists() and not force:
            print(f"[gen-queries] {out_path.name} already exists, skipping. Use --force to regenerate.")
            continue

        group_content = _read(group_file)
        flagged_classes = _FLAGGED_RE.findall(group_content)
        if not flagged_classes:
            print(f"[gen-queries] No Flagged classes in {group_file.name}, skipping.")
            continue

        print(
            f"[gen-queries] {group_file.name}: {len(flagged_classes)} class(es) ...",
            flush=True,
        )

        with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
            for flagged in flagged_classes:
                print(f"  {flagged} ...", flush=True)

                user_content = [
                    {"type": "text", "text": f"=== foundation-core.dle ===\n{core}"},
                    {"type": "text", "text": f"=== {group_file.name} ===\n{group_content}"},
                    {"type": "text", "text": prompt_template.format(flagged=flagged)},
                ]

                with client.messages.stream(
                    model=Models.query_gen,
                    max_tokens=16000,
                    thinking={"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 15999},
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user_content}],
                ) as stream:
                    response = stream.get_final_message()

                result_text = next(
                    (b.text for b in response.content if b.type == "text"), None
                )
                if result_text is None:
                    print(f"  WARNING: no text block for {flagged}, skipping.")
                    continue

                code = extract_single_query(result_text, lang)
                out.write(f"{lang.comment_prefix} {flagged}  ({group_file.name})\n")
                out.write(code)
                out.write("\n\n")
                out.flush()

                if test_run:
                    print("  --test-run: stopping after first class.")
                    return

        print(f"  Written: {out_path.relative_to(_PROJECT_ROOT)}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Generate individual queries for Flagged classes."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--source", choices=["inferred", "extended"], default="inferred",
        help="Which group DL directory to read from.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--lang", choices=["gremlin", "sparql"], default="gremlin",
        help="Which query language to generate.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Overwrite existing output files.")
    parser.add_argument("--test-run", action="store_true", help="Process only the first class and stop.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    source_dir = Paths.dl_inferred if args.source == "inferred" else Paths.dl_extended
    if args.lang == "gremlin":
        lang = GREMLIN
        output_dir = Paths.flagged_queries if args.source == "inferred" else Paths.flagged_extended
    else:
        lang = SPARQL
        output_dir = Paths.flagged_queries_sparql if args.source == "inferred" else Paths.flagged_extended_sparql
    run(source_dir, output_dir, lang=lang, force=args.force, test_run=args.test_run)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
